title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic! — Episode5 An Unsettling Departure

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Event Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Line: Highlands

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm glad that the weather turned out so nice today. Such a lovely day for a picnic and a verdant landscape to match.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, Ena's turned the other way too. This may be a good chance to give Luka a glimpse of this beautiful scenery. Let's see, I need to...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh dear... My phone isn't behaving the way it should. This is unfortunate. Even after she showed me what I'm supposed to do too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Uh, no... It's nothing.
Oh, that reminds me...! Do you think Airi and Mizuki are enjoying the Green Adventure...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They'll probably get along fine. I'm sure everything's going well with them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we still haven't been able to get any answers out of Mizuki yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Mizuki seemed a little down too when we were having lunch. I was hoping that we could talk a little more then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You noticed too, Shizuku?
Mizuki really seems a little off, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It looks like we're having fun, but also like something's missing or not quite right... I can't put my finger on what it is though...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does Mizuki keep making that face...? This is so frustrating...! We're gonna run out of time before we get anywhere...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand why you feel the need to hurry, but we may have more time than you think.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our picnic won't be over for some time and I'll do what I can to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi even said that we should just have as much fun together as we can. I say we do just that...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Also, Ena...
We've been walking for quite some time now. Would you like to take a quick break?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good. I saw a rest area just over there too. I'm gonna go get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll be waiting right here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I tried to cheer her up a little, but Ena still seems so worried.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I hope Airi has some better luck talking to Mizuki than we did...)

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: Hey, uh... Do you happen to be Shizuku Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line:
I knew it!
You looked way too pretty for a regular person.

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: What are the odds that we'd run into you in a place like this?! Can we take a picture together? I really want to tell my friends this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. We decided as a group to avoid taking pictures with our fans until we've gained a little more traction...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Shizuku... Wait, what happened?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Ena...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me. What's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: Huh? Who are you? Does this mean you're an idol too?

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line: Then we should get a picture with all of us in it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please, I'm sorry. I'm not allowed to do that right now.

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: Come on, just one tiny photo...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, you heard her! Leave her alone!
This is her free time, so let her spend it the way she wants...!

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line:
But...
Your fans are begging you. Just one picture...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're still going on about that?
Just because you're her fans, it doesn't mean you can ask her to do whatever you want!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What should I do...? I shouldn't force Ena to talk to them for me like this. There's no way it can end well...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: U-Um, since I'm not allowed to take pictures for the time being, would an autograph work instead? If you don't mind telling me your names, I could...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Don't cave to these cretins!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, Ena.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line: We can have your autograph?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I even brought the penguin notebook Haruka gave me the other day. Here, please have this...

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line: Awesome! Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line:
We'll take good care of these!
Time to tell my friends...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much as well! Oh, and I hope you'll help support my current group, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for what you just did back there, Ena. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't need to thank me. You managed to clear everything up all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, I might've ended up making things a lot worse for you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've sort of always been like this. The kind of person that just says or does what's on their mind, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The same goes for how I feel about Mizuki right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to help, but just rushing in headlong like that might end up making things worse if I'm not careful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, don't say that. I'm grateful for what you did for me just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I would've been able to act if you didn't step in there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'm sure things between you and Mizuki will turn out alright. That's the impression I got from the two of you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You won't be causing each other any trouble. You two really seem to understand one another.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are!
Over here...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're back.
Get any good pics, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A few.
How'd you guys do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great! Mizuki pretty much got every question right! I guess the only downside was that I hardly got any chances to answer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You should've come with us Ena!
It was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So Airi...
Were you able to talk to Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did chat, but I ended up saying that talking with Ena is probably the best option...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, we should probably get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. We can have a relaxing stroll on our way back to the bus.
se_event_picnic_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Ena, what's that on your head...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?
se_event_picnic_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A bee! No, get away!!
Get away from me...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena, calm down!
You'll scare it and make it sting you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I hate bees!
No, it keeps following me...!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, just settle down. Be still and...
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, the trail forks here...
Which way do we go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The map says that the beginner route takes you on a scenic loop around the mountain. Why not get a look at some nice views as we head back to the bus?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds nice... But the sign looks old and worn away... The beginner route is... To the left?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Can we go already?
I'd rather not get eaten by bugs out here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, okay! We're going!
Just stop pushing me...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*... That was more than I was expecting, but I feel more fit now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After we finish cooling off, shall we finish by taking a light hike around the mountain?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay. Hm? Wait, the trail forks here...
Where are we supposed to go?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... There's the beginner route and the advanced route. They both appear to end in the same place too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then let's take the beginner route.
What does this sign say...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on, it's too worn out to read what's on it. I can't tell which way the beginner route is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right, no? If you look closely, it says to go left for the advanced route.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're right. Why did they make it so confusing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The guide says that the advanced route is full of steep cliffs and ledges, so only seasoned hikers should go that way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This sign isn't helping either, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. We should talk to the park rangers about this sign once we get back. Shall we, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's go.
